body:
CHANGELOG updated in EmilyOS: CI: add auto-release job matching PARENA's own pattern -- on every green push to main, auto-bumps a v{major}.{minor+1}.0 tag and publishes a real GitHub Release (regular, not prerelease) with a packaged emilyos-linux-amd64.tar.gz (binary + construct bundle). Previously only uploaded ephemeral, run-scoped CI artifacts with no persistent release (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
